name: AriaOS Neural Memory & Scheduled Automations
description: Manage Aria's persistent self-learning synaptic memory rules, command usage habits, and scheduled background OS automations (RAM optimization, Antivirus quick scan, package sync).

tools.name: list_automations
tools.description: List all learned natural-language neural rules, top usage habits, and scheduled background OS automations.

tools.name: teach_rule
tools.description: Teach Aria a persistent natural-language trigger -> action macro stored in neural_memory.json.

trigger.description: Natural language phrase or trigger keyword (e.g. 'modo stream').

action.description: Target command or action Aria should execute (e.g. 'abre obs y vscodium').

tools.name: delete_rule
tools.description: Delete a learned natural-language rule from Aria's neural memory by trigger.

tools.name: configure_schedule
tools.description: Enable, disable, or change the interval of a recurring background OS automation task.
